title: scenePhase: Save When Backgrounded

docs.title: Managing model data in your app

hints: React to *transitions*, not to the phase value alone.
Save pending edits on the way into `background`; refresh when coming back from it.
jsBridge: `@Environment(\.scenePhase)` tells you when the app goes `active`/`inactive`/`background`, like the web's `visibilitychange` event. Saving on `background` is the iOS equivalent of saving on `pagehide`.
